page.title: Extraction Workbench
page.purpose: Let a tool builder choose an owned extraction challenge, score exact result records, and review the persistent best-score board.

priorities.statement: Make the next challenge and its task instructions immediately findable.
Keep the score submission attached to the selected challenge and name every result by tool.
Show the best saved results and distinguish passing scores from partial results.

states.description: Challenge catalog, selected challenge, submission form and best-score board are ready.
Initial catalog and scoreboard requests are announced while the workbench is loading.
An empty filtered family or an empty scoreboard explains what to do next.
A refresh fails after data loaded; the last loaded catalog or scores remain visible with a refresh warning.
Previously loaded data is shown after a refresh failure and can be retried.
Initial API failure is visible with a retry action.
Score submission is in progress and duplicate submission is disabled.
The tool name or JSON record array needs correction; entered data is preserved.
The score result is shown and the persistent scoreboard refreshes.

regions.purpose: Load the owned challenge catalog and persisted best-score board that make extraction scoring operable.

claims.statement: The extraction workbench remains a named, operable primary region while its range data loads or recovers.
